LanguageData.SettlementServices.Label.BarterPolicy: Pledge goods and silver toward the service price. Each item counts at its market value. No change is returned if you pledge more than the price, and pledged goods are not returned after the request is booked. A cancelled or failed request refunds the service price in silver, never the excess value.
LanguageData.SettlementServices.Label.BarterPolicyInP: Offer goods and silver toward the service price, and optionally take goods from this settlement's trade stock for any value above it. Everything is counted at market value (barter value), which is not the buy and sell price used in the ordinary trade window. Offered goods are not returned after the request is booked. Goods taken from the settlement are yours even if the request is later cancelled or fails, and a cancelled or failed request refunds only the service price in silver. If your offer is worth more than the service plus the goods you take, no change is returned.
